\section{Figures and generated inputs}
% [S7] \includegraphics resolved through \graphicspath with no extension, an
% [H] float (float package), subfigures (subcaption) and \captionsetup
\begin{figure}[H]
  \centering
  \begin{subfigure}{0.3\linewidth}\centering
    \includegraphics[width=1.5cm]{swatch}\caption{Plain.}\label{fig:plain}
  \end{subfigure}\hfill
  \begin{subfigure}{0.3\linewidth}\centering
    \includegraphics[width=1.5cm,angle=90]{swatch.png}\caption{Rotated.}
  \end{subfigure}
  \caption{Two subfigures; \cref{fig:plain} is the first.}
\end{figure}
% [E2] matplotlib PGF: \pgftext changes the catcodes of ^ and % partway through
% its box body, inside a group (see figures/plot.pgf)
\begin{center}\gminputfig{plot.pgf}\end{center}
% [E3] Inkscape PDF+LaTeX output, read after setting \svgwidth; [N20] the
% name resolves only through \input@path (set in master.tex)
\begin{center}\def\svgwidth{0.4\linewidth}\input{drawing.pdf_tex}\end{center}
% [D13] \ifdim inside a TikZ option, with a \foreach list of pairs
\begin{tikzpicture}[>=Stealth]
  \foreach \v/\x in {10/0,60/1}{%
    \node[fill=black!\v, text=\ifdim\v pt>45pt white\else black\fi] at (\x,0) {\v};}
  \draw[->] (0,-0.5) -- (1,-0.5);
\end{tikzpicture}
